messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: I saw a regression on staging during the KV churn test. Paged-attn throughput dropped ~18% with our new small-block config. Profile attached.

sam: Can you paste the perf numbers + the kernel selection logs?

maria: Sure — baseline (block_size=64KB): 12.4k tokens/s; experiment (block_size=16KB): 10.2k tokens/s. KV hit rate went from 82% -> 67% under churn.

jules: Interesting. Do we still pick the high-throughput kernel? Iirc smaller blocks pushed kernel->fallback to compact-mode.

maria: Logs show: kernel_selector chose 'attn_kernel_stream' baseline, but 'attn_kernel_compact' in experiment after workspace fragmentation. Stack snippet:
```
kernel_select(seq_len=2048, workspace_free=1.9GB)
if free_contig < required_stride -> choose 'attn_kernel_compact' (lower mem)
else choose 'attn_kernel_stream' (high-throughput)
```

kevin: Could be allocator causing fragmentation. Our small-block sweep interval is 30s; maybe compaction not triggered during churn. Try lowering repool_threshold.

maria: I ran a quick experiment: repool_threshold=0.2 -> eviction rate down, but CPU overhead up; throughput improved to 11.1k tokens/s. tradeoff.

perf-bot: Perf regression alert: /staging/paged-attn saw 18% drop vs baseline at 2026-03-10T09:31Z

jules: @maria can you run kv cache sampling trace with `KV_TRACE=1`? We need to see contiguous blocks and bucket reuse.

maria: Starting trace now. Also adding adaptive-batch throttle to see interaction with batching heuristics (batch_max=8 -> 6).

kevin: Action items: 1) run kv trace, 2) try repool_threshold=0.1 and enable compaction on low mem pressure, 3) test kernel hint to prefer streaming kernel when kv churn detected.

maria: Working on 1 & 2. Will report numbers in ~40m. /cc @sam @jules

infra-bot: deploy-bot: started canary with repool_threshold=0.1 on staging group 'paged-attn-small-block'

sam: Also add a lightweight regression test to CI: simulate KV churn + short sequences and assert throughput >= 11k tokens/s.

jules: We probably want a unit test around kernel_selector: mock workspace fragmentation and ensure stable kernel choice policy.

maria: Thanks team. I'll paste trace and final numbers when ready :thumbsup:
